formula: - safe_div(numerator=2 * close - high - low, denominator=high - low) * safe_div(numerator=ts_mean(high - low, 5), denominator=ts_mean(close, 5))
rationale: Intraday overreaction detection using the relative close position within the daily range, scaled by recent average range. Extreme positions (close near high/low) with wider ranges signal exhaustion and subsequent reversal.
filter: volume > 0 AND not is_suspend AND close < high_limit AND close > low_limit
